args.code: (() => { const seasonEl = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].find(el => el.innerText && el.innerText.includes('秋季')); const dayEl = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].find(el => el.innerText && el.innerText.match(/第\d+天/)); const moneyEl = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].find(el => el.innerText && el.innerText.includes('元') && el.innerText.includes('💰')); const staminaEl = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].find(el => el.innerText && el.innerText.includes('⚡') && el.innerText.includes('/')); const healthEl = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].find(el => el.innerText && el.innerText.includes('❤️') && el.innerText.includes('/')); return { season: seasonEl ? seasonEl.innerText.trim() : null, day: dayEl ? dayEl.innerText.trim() : null, money: moneyEl ? moneyEl.innerText.trim() : null, stamina: staminaEl ? staminaEl.innerText.trim() : null, health: healthEl ? healthEl.innerText.trim() : null, snippet: document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 800) }; })()
